class.comment:
When the EF DbContext and MediatR UnitOfWorkBehaviour are both present, this extension: 1. Adds HasDbTransaction() to the IUnitOfWork interface so the behavior can detect an externally-managed EF transaction. 2. Implements HasDbTransaction() on ApplicationDbContext (Database.CurrentTransaction != null). 3. Modifies UnitOfWorkBehaviour.Handle to skip TransactionScope when HasDbTransaction() is true — prevents MSDTC escalation when an external party (e.g. NServiceBus ITransactionalSession) already owns the EF connection.
This is an EF concern — not an NServiceBus concern. NServiceBus simply happens to be one caller that externally manages the EF connection.
class.name: UnitOfWorkExternalTransactionExtension
